messages:
Sam (partnerships): Heads up team 1 — MedixCare just went live as an ISV listing on Azure Marketplace and kicked off a HIPAA-scoped private pilot on Redwood Private. Great cross-functional effort!
Rina (AE): Win details: 18-month pilot, reserved capacity commit, and a marketplace procurement flow added. They signed the DPA and SOW yesterday.
Tomas (solutions): CS/solutions will run two pilot workflows: (1) batch results for lab reports, (2) low-latency triage gen for clinician notes. Need model routing config for both.
Nina (privacy): Confirmed PHI boundary: all lab report payloads kept in Private, audit logs retained 1 year. We've requested their BAAs and a HIPAA scoping questionnaire back by EOD.
Ethan (infra): Infra note: allocating a dedicated pool (1x H100 equiv + 1x T4 for preproc), enabling per-tenant KV cache, and strict network egress rules. I'll spin up the environment and post infra ids.
deploy-bot: Private provision job completed for medixcare-pilot. Resources: private-cluster-az-3, kms-key-medix-2024, audit-log-bucket:gs://redwood-logs/medixcare. CI deploy: https://ci.internal/job/medixcare/42
Rina (AE): MedixCare procurement asked for estimated RPS headroom and fallback to a smaller open model if capacity is exhausted. Any product thoughts?
Sam (partnerships): Product/ops, can we offer automatic fallback to a lightweight quantized model and surface a "degrade to best-effort" flag to the customer? They want guarantees on availability over fidelity.
Tomas (solutions): We can route by policy: primary -> pinned model v2.1 q4, fallback -> rtd-small-q8. Need to set expectations in the pilot SLA doc. I'll draft the routing policy.
Nina (privacy): Also pushing for KMS rotation every 30 days and per-user key access logs. MedixCare's security team will audit next week.
Ethan (infra): Noted. I'll enable rotation schedule and share the KMS role mapping. Also creating a sandbox API key with read-only for their devs.
Samira (marketing): Marketing plan: short case study if pilot shows a 20% reduction in triage time and cost per inference improvement. I'll request logo + approval and schedule an exec quote capture in week 3.
Rina (AE): Customer success kickoff tomorrow 11am PT. Agenda: SSO, onboarding keys, test dataset ingestion, and success metrics.
Sam (partnerships): Action items: 1) Legal sign-off on marketplace listing (Samira to confirm), 2) Prod routing + fallback policy (Tomas), 3) KMS + infra artifacts (Ethan), 4) Pilot SLA draft (Nina).
Samira (marketing): I'll coordinate the one-pager and announce internally once we have logo clearance. Congrats team! :confetti_ball:
